meta.name: ui-inventory-scanner
meta.description: Make sure to use this skill whenever the user asks to audit, scan, inventory, or catalogue UI elements in the codebase (e.g., "scan all buttons", "audit all inputs", "list all modals"). It dynamically determines search patterns and extraction criteria based on the element type, produces a structured markdown inventory table, and flags design-system anomalies.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描代码里的界面元素,产出清单并标记设计异常
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你们前端代码量大、组件繁多,想摸清家底并保持设计统一
copy.tagline_en: Inventory your app's UI components and highlight design-system violations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage a large front-end codebase and need a component inventory and design consistency.

howto.what: 你指定一种 UI 元素(如按钮、输入框、弹窗),Claude 会扫描代码库找出全部实例,输出 markdown 清单表,并标出不符合设计系统约定的异常项(如该用共享组件却用了原生代码、缺少无障碍属性等)。
howto.when: 当用户要求审计、扫描、盘点或编目代码库中的 UI 元素时触发,例如说“扫描所有按钮”“审计所有输入框”“列出所有弹窗”;用户说“scan all [元素类型]”也会进入该流程。

say.note: Claude 会输出按钮清单表并标注异常项。
生成输入框清单,标记不符合设计系统之处。
生成弹窗清单,记录实例属性与异常。

howto.what_en: Given a UI element type (button, input, modal, etc.), Claude scans the codebase, returns a markdown inventory table with stats, and flags design-system anomalies (raw HTML vs shared components, missing accessibility).
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to audit, scan, inventory, or catalogue UI elements — e.g., 'scan all buttons', 'audit all inputs', 'list all modals'. Saying 'scan all [type]' enters the flow.

say_en.note: Claude outputs a button inventory table and flags anomalies.
Returns an input inventory and marks design-system issues.
Generates a modal inventory, grouped by screen if many rows.
